info.title: nanoff
info.description: .NET nanoFirmwareFlasher tool to flash firmware images to target devices.

commands.name: flash
commands.description: Flash firmware or custom binaries onto a target device.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Sets the verbosity level of the command. Allowed values are q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal], d[etailed], and diag[nostic]. [default: n]

options.name: --suppressnanoffversioncheck
options.description: Do not check whether a new version of nanoff is available. [default: False]

options.name: --target
options.description: Target name. This is the target name used in the GitHub and Cloudsmith repositories.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform. Acceptable values are: esp32, stm32, cc13x2, efm32, rpi_pico.

options.name: --dfu
options.description: Force USB DFU as the flashing interface (STM32 only). If omitted, along with jtag and nativeswd, the best available interface is auto-detected. [default: False]

options.name: --jtag
options.description: Force JTAG/ST-LINK as the flashing interface (STM32 only). If omitted, along with dfu and nativeswd, the best available interface is auto-detected. [default: False]

options.name: --nativeswd
options.description: Force a generic CMSIS-DAP probe as the flashing interface (STM32 only). If omitted, along with dfu and jtag, the best available interface is auto-detected. [default: False]

options.name: --deviceid
options.description: ID of the device to update (DFU/JTAG/SWD probe, or J-Link probe for EFM32). If not specified the first connected matching device will be used.

options.name: --vcpbaud
options.description: Set baud rate of the J-Link Virtual COM Port (EFM32 only). If not specified it uses the default value for the wire protocol.

options.name: --serialport
options.description: Serial port where device is connected to.

options.name: --fwversion
options.description: Firmware version to flash the device with.

options.name: --preview
options.description: Download a firmware package from the preview repository that includes major changes or experimental features. [default: False]

options.name: --masserase
options.description: Mass erase the device flash before uploading the firmware. [default: False]

options.name: --verify
options.description: Read back flash contents after programming and verify they match the source data. [default: False]

options.name: --reset
options.description: Perform reset on connected device after all other requested operations are successfully performed. [default: False]

options.name: --nofitcheck
options.description: Skip execution of sanity check if the requested target fits the connected device. This is a best effort validation and it's NOT guaranteed to be fail safe. [default: False]

options.name: --image
options.description: Local image file(s) to use instead of downloading from the online repository: a custom CLR binary (when used with target/platform or a bare serial port), or file(s) to flash directly to the device (STM32/Silabs). Raw binary by default; use hex if the file(s) are Intel HEX format.

options.name: --hex
options.description: Treat image as Intel HEX file(s) (self-addressed) instead of raw binary. Only applies to direct STM32 JTAG-connected flashing. [default: False]

options.name: --address
options.description: Address(es) where to flash the image file(s). Hexadecimal format (e.g. 0x08000000). Required when flashing a raw binary image directly (not needed with hex, or when image is a CLR override).

options.name: --backup
options.description: Back up the device's entire current flash contents before flashing (ESP32 only). Takes an optional file path; if omitted, a randomly named file is generated. Omit this keyword entirely to skip the backup (this is the tool-wide default).

options.name: --restore
options.description: Also save a persistent copy of the configuration partition backup (ESP32 only) at this file path. The configuration partition is always automatically backed up before flashing and restored afterward regardless of this keyword; omit the path (or the keyword entirely) to keep the backup in a temporary file that's deleted once it's restored.

options.name: --checkpsram
options.description: Perform check for PSRAM in device. [default: False]

options.name: --fromarchive
options.description: Get the firmware from the firmware archive rather than from the online repository. [default: False]

options.name: --archivepath
options.description: Path of the directory where the firmware is archived. Required when fromarchive is specified.

options.name: --uf2deploy
options.description: Use UF2 mass storage to deploy the application instead of wire protocol. Requires the device to be in BOOTSEL mode. [default: False]

options.name: --baud
options.description: Baud rate to use for the serial port. [default: 1500000]

options.name: --flashmode
options.description: Flash mode to use. [default: dio]

options.name: --flashfreq
options.description: Flash frequency to use [MHz]. [default: 40]

options.name: --partitiontablesize
options.description: Partition table size to use. Valid sizes are: 2, 4, 8 and 16.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy an application image, or a file/network deployment package, to a device.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Sets the verbosity level of the command. Allowed values are q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal], d[etailed], and diag[nostic]. [default: n]

options.name: --suppressnanoffversioncheck
options.description: Do not check whether a new version of nanoff is available. [default: False]

options.name: --target
options.description: Target name. This is the target name used in the GitHub and Cloudsmith repositories.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform. Acceptable values are: esp32, stm32, cc13x2, efm32, rpi_pico.

options.name: --serialport
options.description: Serial port where device is connected to.

options.name: --image
options.description: Path to deployment image file to be uploaded to device.

options.name: --address
options.description: Address where to flash the deployment image. Hexadecimal format (e.g. 0x08040000). Required for STM32 targets; optional for ESP32/RP2040/RP2350 targets, which fall back to the firmware's default deployment partition address.

options.name: --file
options.description: JSON file containing file deployment settings.

options.name: --network
options.description: JSON file containing network deployment settings.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
